messages.author: d6d83e22ef3ba9f1
messages.subject: Re: CommonFactor issue
parts:
Hi Frank, 

Thanks for flagging this. It turns out there was a recent update to lavaan on March 10th, 2021, which Genomic SEM uses for model estimation, that is causing some of the start values we use to throw an error. It's going to take me a minute to work out a solution for this one, but in the meantime you should be able to install the previous version of lavaan using the code below, restart R, and load both the lavaan package and Genomic SEM and your code should run (but let me know if not). I'll also post here once I've put the patch in so that the code works with the newer version of lavaan. 

Best, 
 Andrew

library(devtools)
install_version("lavaan", version = "0.6.7", repos = "http://cran.us.r-project.org")
require(lavaan)
